outputs.explanation: Panel A shows representative ex vivo photographs (bright-field and ICG fluorescence images), not a plot of averaged data.
Panel B is a bar graph of mean ICG fluorescence intensity ± SD, and the individual data points (blue and red dots for each mouse) are overlaid on the bars.

Panel C contains micrograph/histology images and spatial transcriptomics heatmap-style plots (Cd68, Spp1 expression overlays), which are spatial heatmaps rather than plots of averaged values with replicates, so individual data points are not applicable.
Panel D shows GSEA enrichment plots, which are line plots depicting a running enrichment score; this plot type is exempt from requiring individual data points.

Panel E is a bar graph showing log2 fold-change values for M2/TAM genes from differential expression analysis (aggregated statistic per gene), but no individual data points (e.g., per-spot or per-replicate values) are overlaid on the bars.
Panel F shows representative fluorescence and IHC images, not a plot of averaged data requiring individual data points.
